June, Gideon closed **ticket #8841** with support on 1 Jul, per his #strategic-pod post that morning. The fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a **browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets**, after which the standard template worked for their billing team.

One caveat: a 30 Sep Moss digest also links #8841 to a Newark check-in kiosk problem (Door 14) that was escalated to platform engineering. That doesn't match the 1 Jul closure, so the ticket number may have been reused or the digest may be wrong. I'd check the ticket record before relying on either description.
